doc: Right-justifies a decimal integer into a fixed-width character field: writes `value` in base 10 into buf[0..width-1] filling from the least-significant end (buf[width-1]) leftward. Once the running quotient (value/10) hits zero, all remaining (more-significant, i.e. lower-index) positions are filled with spaces instead of '0' digits — this is a "blank-padded" numeric field formatter (e.g. for an HP/score/stat display), not zero-padded. No return value; caller supplies value, field width, and destination buffer pointer.
